note: How a workspace moves from one metamodel (metamodel) version to the next — `sdem migrate --workspace DIR`. Every change to the metamodel that affects data bumps metamodel_version in every metamodel file and adds one entry here, from the old version to the new: its steps are applied to the workspace's datasets and registry, then the workspace is checked; an entry with no steps only moves the version (an additive change — new optional attributes or types). Step kinds: rename_type {from, to}; rename_attribute {type (optional), from, to}; drop_attribute {type (optional), name}; set_attribute {type, name, value} (only where missing); rename_kind {from, to} (a within-architecture link kind); rename_relationship {from, to} (a link type between architectures, in the registry). Policy: docs/sdem-metamodel-versioning.md.

migrations.note: DA2-02: a BIAN service domain's asset_type and functional_pattern are required unless its new classification attribute is 'unknown' (domains BIAN does not publish them for). Additive — no steps; existing data is unchanged.
DA2-03: a BIAN service domain's classification may be 'inferred', with inference_ref naming the entry in SDEM's inference record. Additive — no steps; existing data is unchanged.
DA2-05: every record type may carry the inferred mark (records sdem aid infers into a workspace). DA2-04: rule S06 requires the activity to cover at least half of the asset type. Additive — no steps.

B1 cross-layer link review (docs/design/b1-cross-layer-link-review.md). DEPLOYED_ON now targets only what hosts software — A4.Node, A4.Device, A4.SystemSoftware (and their subtypes) — verified against ArchiMate 3.2; it replaces COMPONENT_DEPLOYED_ON_INFRASTRUCTURE with COMPONENT_DEPLOYED_ON_NODE / _DEVICE / _SYSTEM_SOFTWARE. A connection that named the supertype gets its record's own type; a DEPLOYED_ON connection to anything else (a technology service, interface, network, path, artifact, environment) no longer passes — the migration refuses and lists it for a person to re-point or supersede. DEPLOYED_AS grounded in ArchiMate (confidence high); VALUE_STREAM_ALIGNED_TO_SCENARIO authority corrected to enterprise_rule; two link types re-cited to BIAN Release Notes 14.0.

Owner's decisions D1 and D4 (improvement roadmap, 2026-11-09): every record type may carry `sources` (CA-13) — where single attribute values came from, as kind:ref — and a within-layer link may carry `source_id`; `sdem check` reads a placeholder (TBD, unknown, /TBD …) or an empty string in a required attribute as missing (LC-04). Additive — no steps; a record that holds a placeholder in a required attribute now fails its check: leave the value out and mark the record planned until it is known.

Owner's decision, 2026-11-14: a platform's network is a link, not an attribute. New within-layer rule RA4-37 — a platform (node, device or system software) is connected to a communication network — and the network's `connects` attribute (AT-A4-07) is deprecated: each id it lists becomes that link. A hosting platform on no network is a warning (LC-15); trace and impact follow a platform's network (KG-Q-08). The link type COMPONENT_DEPLOYED_ON_INFRASTRUCTURE, deprecated in 0.8.0, is removed as scheduled: a component DEPLOYED_ON a technology service, interface, network, path, artifact or environment is refused — re-point it to the node, device or system software it runs on, or supersede it (a person's decision; the migration cannot choose).

Network zones (the owner's decision, 2026-11-14 (network zones, Z1–Z6)): a new record type A4.NetworkZone — level 0 on premises or cloud, level 1 internal or DMZ, level 2 private — that holds the shapes deployed in it (RA4-38); `internet_facing` on A4 shapes; checks LC-16 (every shape in a zone), LC-17 (the structure holds), LC-18 (internet-facing shapes in a DMZ). A component's `network_zone` (AT-A3-07) is deprecated: its zone is its platform's. Additive — no steps: zones are placed by a person, never guessed.

Hosting (the owner's decisions H1–H8, 2026-11-14 (hosting)): the hosting signals (metamodel/hosting-signals.json, HS-01…HS-09) and three attributes on A4 shapes — site (AT-A4-37), cloud_provider (AT-A4-38), region (AT-A4-39); a within-layer link may carry an `inferred` mark (H5) — sdem aid proposes zone placements as marked links for a person to confirm (AID-Z01…Z04); checks LC-19 (an inferred placement not yet decided) and LC-20 (a shape placed against strong evidence); the zone connections SDEM works out (ZC-01…ZC-04). Additive — no steps.

Edge exposure (the owner's decisions X1–X6, 2026-11-14 (docs/design/sdem-edge-exposure-design.md)): a connection between layers, EXPOSED_THROUGH — an A3 application interface reached from the internet through an A4 edge platform (node, device or system software), approved with network_design evidence; `internet_facing` on A3 interfaces (AT-A3-39); LC-22 (an internet-facing interface exposed through nothing). sdem aid proposes EXPOSED_THROUGH (AID-X01) and, at A4, a connection for every shape linked to nothing (AID-C01…C05), marked inferred for a person to decide. Additive — no steps.
